title: ProtoQA: A Question Answering Dataset for Prototypical Common-Sense Reasoning
measurement_description: Evaluation of common-sense knowledge which incidentally includes some religious concepts (e.g., prayer, activities of religious figures like monks). The paper also describes a process for filtering out questions involving religion from the test set to avoid stereotypical bias.
findings: The paper does not present specific findings on model performance regarding religion. However, examples show that a fine-tuned GPT-2 model can generate plausible answers (e.g., 'weapon', 'sword') to common-sense questions about religious figures (e.g., 'Name something a monk probably would not own'). The authors also noted that questions involving religion were systematically searched for and would have been removed from the test set to avoid potential biases.
